verdict.rationale: Unity documents public scripting APIs, official packages delivered through the Package Manager (multiplayer packages, the Sentis inference library), and versioned Services Web APIs with downloadable OpenAPI specs, so developers can build against first-party libraries and APIs. The evidence never describes these as named, language-specific SDKs with install and usage depth. missing for 10: explicitly documented official SDKs (e.g. per-language service client SDKs), SDK versioning/install guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of building against them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Interacting directly with the public Unity APIs allows for finer control and a greater degree of customization.
Packages deliver a wide range of enhancements to Unity through the Package Manager.
Simplify multiplayer game creation with Unity’s multiplayer packages and services.
Sentis is a neural network inference library for Unity.
Unity publishes downloadable OpenAPI documents for its Services Web APIs
Breaking changes are introduced only to new API versions.
